action.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * a.actual / b.budget, 2) AS pct_of_h1_budget_used FROM (SELECT SUM(debit - credit) AS actual FROM gl_lines WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') a, (SELECT SUM(amount) AS budget FROM budgets WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND account_id = '6500' AND period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-06') b
